title: OrchestrationDeliveryCreatedPayload
description: Payload of `orchestration.delivery.created` version 1. A store accepted a delivery order and its delivery was written down, before any Provider is asked: one per order however many times the acceptance is heard, with the pickup at the ready time and the drop at the promised time, each moved up to the next five minutes, and when its offers go out. The envelope's `partner_id` is the store's Partner and its `correlation_id` follows the order. Read the delivery at `GET /v1/partners/{partner_id}/deliveries/{delivery_id}` or `GET /v1/platform/deliveries/{delivery_id}`. Consumers must ignore fields they do not know; new optional fields are an additive change.

number.description: The order's number, as said aloud.

location_id.description: The store it is picked up from.

partner_id.description: The store's Partner; the envelope's `partner_id` too.

attempt.description: Which delivery of the order: 1, or more once the order was sent again.

previous_state.description: The state before; `null` for a new delivery.

version.description: The delivery's version after the change; it only rises, and `delivery.changed` signals carry it.

provider_kind.description: The kind of Provider that has it; `null` while none does.

service_id.description: The delivery service that has it, for an agent-based Provider.

agent_id.description: The Agent it is about, where one is named.

pickup_at.description: When the Agent should be at the store.

drop_at.description: When the Agent should be at the door.

release_at.description: When its offers go out; `null` when released at once.

chain.description: The kinds of Provider it may go to, in order; empty when the store names none.

drop_code_required.description: Whether the drop needs the customer's code.
